evidence: We deploy AI and other emerging technologies in various facets of our operations and we continue to explore the development and use of AI technologies.
We have also entered into, and may continue to enter into, partnerships and collaborations relating to the use of AI technology to aid in drug discovery and other efforts.

we have expanded relationships with contract manufacturing organizations, entities supporting consumer directed access channels, artificial intelligence vendors, and other third parties in recent periods.
The rapid advancement of these technologies presents opportunities for us in research, manufacturing, commercialization, and other business endeavors
ai_positioning.summary: LLY intègre l'IA dans ses opérations internes (découverte de médicaments, fabrication, commercialisation) via des partenariats avec des fournisseurs IA, mais adopte une posture défensive en soulignant les risques réglementaires, cybersécuritaires et concurrentiels associés.
